[ALERT pagerduty] escalating the issue since P17 is unavailable. Checking the status of the Postgres server and the read replica.

```javascript
svc_status(namespace="default", service="postgres")
svc_status(namespace="default", service="read_replica")
```

If the issue persists, I will look into alternate methods to gather the required data, such as manually querying the primary database or checking the logs for the jobs service.

Once I have the data, I will investigate the causes of the job failures and take appropriate action to get the backlog moving again. If necessary, I will restart the jobs service and the Postgres server.

After taking the necessary actions, I will submit my findings and recommended next steps using the `submit_report` function.
